meta.name: maintainer-decline
meta.description: Guide for drafting issue closure and decline responses as an open-source package maintainer. Use when helping compose a reply that says "no" to a feature request, closes an issue as won't-fix, redirects a user to a different package, explains why a design choice is intentional, or otherwise declines or closes a community contribution. Also use when the maintainer needs to explain a deprecation, point out a user misunderstanding, or communicate an effort/scope tradeoff to a contributor.

copy.tagline: 撰写开源维护者的拒绝与关闭回复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是开源包维护者，需要礼貌地关闭议题或拒绝功能请求。
copy.tagline_en: Draft decline and closure responses for open-source maintainers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an open-source package maintainer needing to politely close issues or decline feature requests.
